title: Listen to Inez
why: Take 2 has the most life: the door comes first, Inez hides behind the debt, and that excuse fails. "He said nothing. You just did." is the best line in any take, and it is the moment she gives herself away. The debt and affair as lever and need match [c407d23e4f6647fe2f4315a1] and [96030c4c4a1a18523a3fdbbb].
changes: Cut what the sheet doesn't give: the count of six looks and the clockwork collector. Milena's rebuttal is now her own debt, "I owe them too", which also shows both women owe the Bureau.
Milena now says only "that guard" and Inez blurts the name Okafor herself. This makes "You just did" literally true and shows clearly who Okafor is.
Replaced the "I count things" and "What's it paying?" lines with "You jump at everything", so Inez being nervous by nature is stated by someone with a reason to say it.

Replaced the closing question with "Then stop looking. You can't afford it." It is shorter, sounds like Milena, and implies no threat or bargain. Waiting tables and the terrace now place Inez at this café.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You've been looking at the Office door all shift, Inez.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who else has noticed? I've got the terrace to see to.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You jump at everything. Nobody watches a door for nothing.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: It's the Bureau, that's all. Waiting tables here, I can't keep up.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: I owe them too. I don't keep looking at that guard.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Did Okafor say something? Who else has he told?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: He said nothing. You just did.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Yes, I'm seeing him. If the Office hears, it costs us both.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Then stop looking. You can't afford it.

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Bureau loan, behind, could be cleared. Okafor, Office door, could be used.

learned: Debt: Bureau loan, and she's behind.
Secret: seeing Okafor, the door guard.
opens: Pressure: threaten to expose the affair.
